# Workspace Notes

This is a Vite + TypeScript + Three.js first-person voxel-world game. Keep terrain generation deterministic for a given seed and biome. Keep the game scene, first-person controls, and in-game HUD in `src/main.ts`; keep terrain height, chunk mesh, and tree generation in `src/terrain.ts`. Validate changes with `npm run build` when Node.js is available.
